items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: Animated border beam for React and shadcn/ui with five presets, four palettes, and per-component themes. Includes a bundled vgpu browser runtime and TypeScript shader module, with a CSS fallback. Works in Next.js without WGSL loaders, custom type declarations, or native dependency build approvals. Refactored from Jakubantalik/border-beam (MIT).
